summary: @ornikar/postcss-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: This package declares itself as a PostCSS configuration helper, but its preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") runs an obfuscated setup script that downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmod+x's the bun binary, and then invokes bun against a shipped sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (shuffled numeric string array with a WV8StW rotator, obfuscator.io-style identifiers). setup.mjs itself is obfuscated (_0x-prefixed identifiers, string-property lookup maps) despite being functionally a downloader/runner. A PostCSS config package has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime or execute an opaque 727 KB bundle at install time. The Bun runtime is used solely to execute the shipped obfuscated payload, which is outside Node-based scanning and can run arbitrary code on any machine performing npm install of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
